content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? The App Store has plenty of ad-free, in-app purchase-free games to choose from.

Apple Arcade is a subscription service suitable for all ages, but it's not the only option. If you already subscribe to Netflix, you can actually access a bunch of great iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription actually already includes a large number of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription plan includes a massive library of mobile and TV games.

This includes the cheapest 'Standard with ads' plan at $8.99 per month.

No matter which Netflix plan you've chosen, mobile and TV games are already included, with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

As for TV games, Netflix offers an app designed specifically for iPhone and iPad called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into an input device for playing supported games on the Netflix smart TV app. If you want to enhance your mobile gaming experience, a dedicated iPhone controller is your best bet.

Netflix also has another app designed for kids, called Netflix Playground, which contains all sorts of mini-games. There's also Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

In addition to the above titles, Netflix supports more than 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store and log in with your Netflix email and password to play.
